# General

1. If you start fresh, read the doc start skills (`doc-start`). They will inshallah tell you how to read the doc start md file.
2. For efficient searching in docs and code, read the `search` skill.
3. Don't use AI agents unless the user asks for them.

# Coding related

1. When you start coding, read the `coding` skill and the `file-tree-optimization` skill first. They apply to every coding task, not only big changes. For a big change, also suggest a file tree to maintain/optimize code readability and scalability. The `refac-cli` skill can help to move or rename files, folders, and symbols.
2. No soft fallbacks. We prefer hard errors with very descriptive error messages. They inshallah help to debug quickly.
3. Short and to-the-point comments are helpful. They help others understand decisions (user defined, performance, etc.).
